splitstone.tutorial.title: Tutorial
splitstone.tutorial.opening.title: Your first run
splitstone.tutorial.opening.text: This is a practice run on a set world, to show how speedrunners beat Minecraft. Nobody is racing you and nothing counts. Follow the goals at the top left; each box ticks when you do it, and a portal stays shut until its stage's goals are done. If you die, the stage you are on starts again as it was when you reached it. You can skip the tutorial at any time from the pause menu.
splitstone.tutorial.finished.title: You beat Minecraft in %s.
splitstone.tutorial.finished.text: In a match you race another player on the same world. You earned the Graduate badge.
splitstone.tutorial.skipped.title: Tutorial skipped.
splitstone.tutorial.skipped.text: You can play it any time from Practice.
splitstone.tutorial.card.blacksmith.titl: Find the blacksmith and loot its chest.
splitstone.tutorial.card.blacksmith.text: The blacksmith's chest has iron to start you off.
splitstone.tutorial.card.village_map.tex: Here is what is around you. Choose your own way between them.
splitstone.tutorial.card.bridge_video.te: Watch how speedrunners route a bridge bastion, then come back. Video: Bridge Bastion Guide (All Useful Routes), by HiTrippy.
splitstone.tutorial.card.ninjabrain_vide: Ninjabrain Bot works out where the stronghold is from your eye throws. Download it, watch how to use it, then come back. Video: Ninjabrain Bot (Boat Eye Tutorial), by HiTrippy.
splitstone.tutorial.card.one_cycle_video: Speedrunners kill the dragon with beds, which explode in the End. Watch how, then come back. Video: Never Fail a 1 Cycle Again, by HiTrippy.
Watch how speedrunners find the fortress, then come back. Video: How To Find The BASTION & FORTRESS (MCSR Ranked Guide), by PudgyPenguinMCSR.
splitstone.tutorial.card.portal_room_vid: Watch how speedrunners find the portal room in a stronghold, then come back. Video: Preemptive Stronghold Navigation in 3 minutes, by meebie.
splitstone.tutorial.shut: This portal stays shut until you have ticked: %s
splitstone.tutorial.hint.overworld.0: The blacksmith's chest has iron to start you off.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.overworld.1: Mine cobblestone for the axe. The iron for the pickaxe and the shovel is in the chest.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.overworld.2: Break gravel near water until it drops flint. Hay bales make bread. The golem drops iron.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.overworld.4: At the lava pool, pour water onto lava to make obsidian in the shape of a portal frame, then light it.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.nether.0: Set Entity Distance to 500%% and Render Distance to 16 in Video Settings. Then press F3 and turn towards where the E number is biggest: that is where the piglins are.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.bastion.0: Throw gold ingots to the piglins. Wear gold armour or they attack. Chests count too.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.fortress.0: Blazes come out of spawners on the fortress.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.fortress.1: Every blaze drops a rod here.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.fortress.2: Speedrunners craft for the End fight before they leave the Nether.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.fortress.3: This is blind travel. Build the portal with your obsidian and light it.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.blind.0: Throw an eye, look at it, press F3+C; Ninjabrain Bot works out where the stronghold is.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.stronghold.0: Unbreakable blocks are obsidian, crying obsidian and respawn anchors.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.stronghold.1: Put an eye in each empty frame.
splitstone.tutorial.hint.end.0: Beds explode in the End. Place one where the dragon's head will be and click it.
